Yo Yo Honey Singh Skips Maharashtra Cyber Police Summons

Rapper Yo Yo Honey Singh failed to appear before the Maharashtra Cyber Police on Tuesday, having been summoned in connection with alleged indecent remarks made during a concert in Delhi. The summons was issued by the Maharashtra Cyber Police.
